_doc: [onboard] The Signal Tower (story/signal_tower.gd): WREN can only reach Lumi through it. Tier 0 is the broken mast in the yard; each tier raises the relay signal (signal_pct) and WREN's clarity (Wren.stage(): tier 1 crackly, 2 clearer, 3+ clear) and unlocks the lines she couldn't send. Costs in the three currencies only.
